episodes.title: There's No Creature Like Snow Creature
episodes.summary: The gang travels to a mountain resort in Tibet to watch a snowboarding competition. They end up investigating rumors of a snow creature that is attacking the participants.

episodes.title: 3-D Struction
episodes.summary: A giant dinosaur, El Oloroso, comes to life and rampages through a museum in Central America.

episodes.title: Space Ape at the Cape
episodes.summary: While visiting a space center, a mysterious alien egg hatches. The gang must stop this shape-shifting creature before NASA's shuttle is aborted.

episodes.title: Big Scare in the Big Easy
episodes.summary: The ghosts of two rival Civil War soldiers haunt a New Orleans necropolis.

episodes.title: It's Mean, It's Green, It's the Mystery Machine
episodes.summary: When the Mystery Machine comes to life and begins driving by itself, the gang tries to find the clues, which leads them to The Mystery Kids, the band who formerly owned the Mystery Machine.

episodes.title: Riva Ras Regas
episodes.summary: A big star's debut concert in new Las Vegas is sabotaged by a ghost from old Las Vegas.

episodes.title: Roller Ghoster Ride!
episodes.summary: An amusement park full of extreme rides is haunted by the Roller Ghoster, a speed-happy spectre who frightens patrons off the thrill rides.

episodes.title: Safari, So Goodi!
episodes.summary: Daphne's video safari goes in search of disappearing African animals and gets derailed by animalistic demons.

episodes.title: She Sees Sea Monsters at the Sea Shore
episodes.summary: The gang's tropical island vacation gets ruined when they stumble across a boat-smashing sea monster. The terrifying ocean creature, Notto Mori, is reputedly known as the spirit of the island.

episodes.title: A Scooby-Doo! Christmas
episodes.summary: The gang gets stranded in a town where a headless snowman is on the loose and Christmas isn't celebrated.

episodes.title: Toy Scary Boo
episodes.summary: Toys come to life in the local shopping mall, and the gang stays overnight to investigate.

episodes.title: Lights! Camera! Mayhem!
episodes.summary: The gang visits the set of a spy movie and encounters the ghost of a teen idol.

episodes.title: Pompeii and Circumstance
episodes.summary: The gang's Italian vacation is interrupted by misdeeds in the ancient city of Pompeii leading to an ominous visit into the mouth of the maybe not-so-dormant volcano Vesuvius.

episodes.title: The Unnatural
episodes.summary: The spectre of a famous ballplayer appears to stop a current home run hitting star from breaking his record.

episodes.title: Big Appetite in Little Tokyo
episodes.summary: The gang travels to Tokyo, Japan. A mystical person zaps a pizza with a monster-transformation spell and Shaggy eats the pizza! He starts to grow into a Godzilla-like monster whenever he goes to sleep and he starts eating everything in sight.

episodes.title: Mummy Scares Best
episodes.summary: The Mystery Inc. gang travels to Egypt, where a mummy is on the loose and turning everyone into Zombies on an archaeological dig.

episodes.title: The Fast and the Wormious
episodes.summary: In Mexico, the gang tries to stop a giant sand worm from wreaking havoc on the Enduro Slam 5000 off-road race.

episodes.title: High-Tech House of Horrors
episodes.summary: The Mystery Inc. gang gets trapped in an automated house of the future that goes berserk.

episodes.title: The Vampire Strikes Back
episodes.summary: While visiting the Hex Girls at a Transylvania Castle, the gang runs into a real-life vampire.

episodes.title: A Scooby-Doo Halloween
episodes.summary: The gang visits Velma's relatives during a Halloween festival headlined by Kiss but the festivities are interrupted by the ghost of the town's founder and a bevy of living scarecrows.

episodes.title: Homeward Hound
episodes.summary: The secret six puppies are dognapped from the dog show, and it's up to Scooby-Doo and the gang to rescue them.

episodes.title: The San Franpsycho
episodes.summary: While attending the Grind Games, the gang runs into the ghost of an Alcatraz prisoner, who is targeting members of the competition.

episodes.title: Simple Plan and the Invisible Madman
episodes.summary: While traveling to the Montreal Rock Festival, Scooby and company rescue the band Simple Plan from an invisible madman.

episodes.title: Recipe for Disaster
episodes.summary: After Shaggy wins a trip to the Sccoby Snack Factory, the gang prepare for a well deserved holiday. Unfortunately, the ghost of a former employee is lurking in the shadows!

episodes.title: Large Dragon at Large
episodes.summary: The gang attends a Renaissance Faire, where a dragon interrupts their fun!

episodes.title: Uncle Scooby and Antarctica
episodes.summary: Scooby-Doo and the gang accompany a penguin back to its home in Antarctica and find a finned creature from the sea dragging victims to an icy fate.

episodes.title: New Mexico, Old Monster
episodes.summary: The gang travels to New Mexico and finds a giant, ancient legendary bird that carries the locals off to its mysterious lair.

episodes.title: It's All Greek to Scooby
episodes.summary: A medallion Shaggy wears apparently causes an ancient myth to come to life as the Mystery Inc. gang travels in Greece.

episodes.title: Fright House of a Lighthouse
episodes.summary: Residents of a small Midwestern town are frightened when an abandoned lighthouse is haunted.

episodes.title: Go West, Young Scoob
episodes.summary: The Mystery Inc. gang visits a robot resort for living out Western movie fantasies. Then the robots turn on the gang.

episodes.title: A Scooby-Doo Valentine
episodes.summary: When Scooby and the gang return to Coolsville for Valentine's Day, they discover that teenagers are being kidnapped form Lover's Lane -- and they are the prime suspects. To make matters worse, Shaggy learns that his former girlfriend is now dating JC Chasez!

episodes.title: Wrestle Maniacs
episodes.summary: When the Coolsville Wrestling Federation seems to be haunted, Carol Colossal calls on Shaggy and company for help. Scooby-Doo and his pals prove their skills in a ghostly match.

episodes.title: Ready to Scare
episodes.summary: The gang goes to Paris to see Daphne's cousin become model of the year. But they find she's been abducted by a giant gargoyle.

episodes.title: Farmed and Dangerous
episodes.summary: The kids visit the Secret Six puppies on their farm--only to discover the farm is being haunted by the Demon Farmer!

episodes.title: Diamonds Are a Ghouls Best Friend
episodes.summary: The ghost of a Russian hockey player shows up to ruin the international world cup hockey event.

episodes.title: A Terrifying Round with a Menacing Metallic Clown
episodes.summary: Shaggy competes in a mini golf tournament that is terrorized by a giant metallic clown.

episodes.title: Camp Comeoniwannascareya
episodes.summary: Shaggy and Scooby are camp counselors when a ghost story comes to life!

episodes.title: Block-Long Hong Kong Horror
episodes.summary: The gang's in Hong Kong when a festive fake dragon comes to life and rampages!

episodes.title: Gentlemen, Start Your Monsters!
episodes.summary: The gang goes to a champion stock car race--and finds a pit stop with mayhem!

episodes.title: Gold Paw
episodes.summary: The gang goes to Fort Knox army base to visit the Secret Six puppies--and encounters a solid gold ghoul!

episodes.title: Reef Grief!
episodes.summary: The gang goes to Australia's Great Barrier Reef so Shaggy and Scooby can compete in a sand-castle contest. There they find a coral creature and disappearing teenagers!

episodes.title: E-Scream
episodes.summary: Video game characters come to life and menace the Mystery Inc. gang while they attend a game convention.
